from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference/play/users/u061/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    ones = [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v == 1]
    sixes = [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v == 6]
    pairs = []
    for i, (r1,c1) in enumerate(ones):
        for r2,c2 in ones[i+1:]:
            dr, dc = r2-r1, c2-c1
            if abs(dr) == abs(dc) and dr != 0:
                sr, sc = (1 if dr > 0 else -1), (1 if dc > 0 else -1)
                cells = [(r1+k*sr,c1+k*sc) for k in range(abs(dr)+1)]
                on_line = [p for p in sixes if p in cells]
                pairs.append((len(on_line), abs(dr), cells, sr, sc))
    if pairs:
        active = [p for p in pairs if p[0] > 0]
        selected = active if active else [max(pairs, key=lambda p:p[1])]
        for _,_,cells,_,_ in selected:
            for r,c in cells:
                out[r][c] = 1
        # A six on a connected one-diagonal marks the crossing; complete the
        # perpendicular diagonals through all six markers.
        if active:
            _,_,_,sr,sc = max(active, key=lambda p:p[1])
            for r,c in sixes:
                dr,dc = sr,-sc
                rr,cc=r,c
                while 0 <= rr-dr < h and 0 <= cc-dc < w:
                    rr-=dr; cc-=dc
                while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                    out[rr][cc]=6
                    rr+=dr; cc+=dc
    return out
'''
